# The Lamp Under a Bushel (Matthew 5:15)

## Emotional Focus
Letting your light shine for Jesus.

## Key KJV
“Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.” (Matthew 5:15)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus said no one lights a lamp and hides it under a basket. They put it on a stand so it gives light to everyone. Let your light shine!

## Coloring Prompt
A bright lamp on a stand shining light into a dark room.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Let your light shine for Jesus.”
